ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the M1-2 Limited

Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols as shown on Map No. 12-K

in the area bounded by:

West 47" Street; A line 267.49 feet east of and parallel to South Inox Avenue; a line

193.37 feet south of and parallel to West 47 Street; and South Knox Avenue.

To those of an M2-2 Light Industry District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4601-25 W. 47" Street
